# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** Delegate to the W.F.M.S. conference  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Winifred has blonde hair worn in a tiny, rigid bun secured with a firm elastic band under a large sun-hat. She has a healthy, circular pink-and-white complexion and cheerful, dark brown eyes. She wears spectacles and is known for her unique style of dress, often wearing blue-and-white striped aprons over printed wrappers, yet maintaining a stately and dignified presence.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c8 P22](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0022), [v4 c27 P35](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0035)_

## Personality

Winifred is famous for having a sharp, sarcastic tongue alongside a deeply compassionate heart, regularly turning up to help neighbors during difficulties. She is an outspoken critic of men and holds a strong prejudice against Methodists. Highly confident in her abilities, she speaks with straightforward honesty and harbors a sharp sense of humor. Despite her rigid principles, she enjoys friendly verbal sparring with long-time acquaintances and cares deeply for her friends.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c8 P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 c8 P45](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0045), [v4 c8 P59](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0059), [v4 c15 P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 c18 P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 c30 P34](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0034)_

## History

Winifred resides in a bright emerald house in Seven Gulls, where she has lived for many years. She regularly visits her neighbor Nell Carrow, bonding over shared views and identifying her as one of the few people who 'know Joseph.' Known for assisting neighbors in distress, she hand-sews garments for expected infants, such as the Proctor family's eighth child, and aids grieving mothers like Nell after the loss of her newborn. She also acts as a close friend and confidante to Lorna Vane, fiercely sympathizing with Lorna's tragic past and resenting Adrian Treleaven when he causes Lorna heartache. When Hugh Carrow proposes a medical intervention for Laurence Vane (believed to be Rufus Vane), Winifred strongly opposes it out of protective concern for Lorna. During the summer, she serves as a delegate to the W.F.M.S. conference in Portmaris alongside Mrs. Thomas Holt. Eventually, despite her long-standing complaints about men, she surprises Nell and Hugh by announcing her engagement to her long-time suitor, Ambrose Kerr.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P35](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0035), [v4 c7 P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P25](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0025), [v4 c8 P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 c10 P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 c11 P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c28 P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 c30 P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032), [v4 c30 P34](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0034), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Raised as an only child for eight years before her brother was born  <sub>[v4 c34 P26](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0026)</sub>
- Her only brother died fifteen years prior  <sub>[v4 c28 P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007)</sub>
- Her cousin Flora lost her husband to suicide  <sub>[v4 c11 P2](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0002)</sub>
- Won an award for lemon pies at the Port Marlow Exhibition a decade prior  <sub>[v4 c10 P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035)</sub>
- Courted by suitors in her youth, including Amos Hollis and Ambrose Kerr  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010), [v4 c37 P16](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0016)</sub>
